description: NeurOn lifecycle-hook gate (plan 004 §4). Installed by sync.ps1/sync.sh, which substitutes the real install path into the command strings. Sync handlers ONLY (never async — async UserPromptSubmit cannot block). Timeouts: 300/10/60 s. The gate waits at most min(NEURON_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 290) s so it always emits an explicit decision before the 300 s hook timeout.
